featured_image.prompt: ICSB | Hero cover for a marketing playbook: “AI UGC-style ad ideas + scripts + variations”. Clean, modern, minimal, green-centered gradient (emerald → mint) with generous white space. Central concept: a simple card stack labeled Hook / Proof / CTA, plus subtle icons for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. No brand logos. High-contrast typography area reserved for headline. Style: sleek, professional, Stripe-inspired soft 3D, smooth gradients, uncluttered.

diagrams.prompt: ICSB | Concept map diagram summarizing 10 AI UGC-style ad ideas. Show a 3-column matrix: Hook type (Routine / Proof demo / POV / Skit / Tap-to-result), Proof beat (Before/after / Close-up / Montage / Screen+gesture), CTA type (Try / Buy / Save / Install / Learn). Place each of the 10 concepts as a labeled node in the matrix. Minimal, green-centered palette, lots of white space, clean lines, readable labels.
